name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: A Russian strike hit Zaporizhzhia flats on 13 Nov, injuring 30; power cuts in half of regions as talks widen to Europe
state: Russia launched 117 drones overnight on 12–13 Nov; a strike on Zaporizhzhia city on 13 Nov hit two apartment blocks and injured 30 people, and attacks on energy sites caused outages in about half of Ukraine's regions (AP via CP24). Ukraine sent nearly 1,200 drones at Russia the same night, setting the Volgograd refinery on fire (Kyiv Independent). US envoys said on 12 Nov that further talks will include Europe; no ceasefire is in place. Mass strikes on cities and the grid, after the 9 Nov nuclear-plant safety incident, keep the Alert.
for_you: Civilians in Ukrainian cities face strikes and power cuts as winter starts. Travellers should follow FCDO advice against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on refineries and ports can move energy and grain markets.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass strikes on cities and the power grid (30 injured in Zaporizhzhia 13 Nov) after a nuclear-plant safety incident on 9 Nov

sources.title: CP24 (AP) — Ukraine launches nearly 1,200 drones at Russia; U.S.-led talks consider wider European security

why: Europe's largest war since 1945 shapes European security, energy, food exports and defence budgets.
drivers: Front-line offensives, strike campaigns on energy, Western aid, negotiations, nuclear plant safety.

rubric.alert: Significant escalation — major new offensive, mass-casualty strikes, a nuclear-plant safety incident, or new state involvement.
rubric.watch: Active war at sustained intensity, or a ceasefire under strain.
